contentText: The result was not enough to win outright, but enough to shake Germany and Europe to their core: the far-right Alternative  für Deutschland trounced the ruling conservatives in the impoverished former East German state of Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday. We ask about the consequences of voting for an anti-immigrant, pro-Russian party that wants schools to teach less about the ills of Hitler and more about the glory of Bismarck.
